summary.name: Skeuomorphism (Digital and 3D Aesthetics). Supplemental design reference, not a directly named style in the source collection.
summary.visualIdentity: Interface elements resemble specific physical controls, materials, and mechanisms. Lighting, edges, and shadows must match across the scene. Presses and rotations align with the state change they cause. Labels stay readable, and the physical resemblance must serve a functional purpose.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly suited to interface concepts where physical resemblance aids use, such as audio plugin UIs, hardware companion apps, and tutorials. Premium hardware simulators are a listed pairing. Inferred: product demonstrations of physical controls. Also listed as a good fit for exploded reveal and camera orbit patterns.
summary.limitations: Avoid or adapt when decorative textures lack function, engraved labels have low contrast, or lighting differs between controls. Heavy image weights are a risk on mobile. Palette checks are two-color only. Simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production or validated physics.
summary.palette: Authored example, reference-dependent, for new presentation elements only: background #E7DFD0, foreground #3A352D, accent_1 #8B7151. Foreground on background measures 9.185:1, meeting the 4.5:1 normal-text target. Accent on background measures 3.465:1 and is decorative only. No gradient is enabled. Task or brand colors override these, and source assets keep their colors.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Controls such as knobs rotate with detents, and readouts update to match. Presses and rotations must map to timed state changes. Optional motion references include voice-card tilt (motion-011), chapter handoff (motion-012), swipe carousel (motion-013), storytelling (motion-015), exploded reveal (motion-017, only for separable components), and camera orbit (motion-021, requires real 3D). None is mandatory.
summary.audio: The source does not mandate any audio layer. Suggest choices from the topic, audience, and motion, and honor any explicit user requirements. Sound for knob detents or presses is plausible but unspecified in the source. Keep narration intelligible, avoid competing vocals, and verify audio alignment in the final video.
summary.assetRequirements: Subject, exact copy, and assets come from the task; none are supplied here. Source artwork, product interfaces, and materials keep their original colors. Prerendered photoreal material plates are optional and must match CSS shadows. Fonts and local assets must load before rendering. Labels remain live DOM text.
summary.combinations: Skeuomorphism alone suits interface concepts. Pairing with style-095 (product motion) times detent feedback and state readouts, with accessible focus and visible state change. Pairing with style-061 adds prerendered material sprites under live labels. Keep light direction consistent across all controls.
summary.productionApproach: HTML/CSS and SVG handle visual construction, with materials, lighting, and labels owned by the style renderer. GSAP owns motion as a paused, seekable timeline; Motion is optional and needs verified synchronization. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for assembly and export. Remotion is a fallback only when a verified limitation is recorded. Validate with hyperframes check, snapshot, and render, then inspect decoded frames and direct seeks.
